purpose: Rank native reacting-substrate resemblance to adipate/HMDA; not enzyme activity or yield
eligibility: Free-acid/carbon-bound-primary-amine amidation with stoichiometric substrate copies; at least one new amide
rationale: Reuse the existing substrate-level component weights as transparent chemical judgments, with no hard architecture, ring or aromaticity exclusions and no forced zero score for terminal amides. Carbon spacers count carbon atoms only. No original reaction IDs are pinned.
